sections.heading: Telecom IT services for connected operations
sections.body:
Billing exceptions, disconnected support channels and legacy applications make service operations harder to coordinate. Linkfields combines enterprise application integration, automation and governed operational insight with owned software and reusable accelerators.

We connect customer channels, CRM and billing workflows so teams can review exceptions, track hand-offs and plan change. The focus is enterprise software and data integration, not network-equipment engineering; system interfaces, security boundaries and telecom-specific requirements are agreed during discovery.

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Each workflow is scoped around your systems and business requirements, with accountable teams and agreed acceptance measures.

items.title: Billing and reconciliation exceptions
items.description: When billing records and payment status diverge, teams need a reviewable exception queue.
items.bullets:
Workflow - Connect billing and finance inputs; route mismatches with supporting records.
Control - Finance owners approve corrections; access and change history remain traceable.
items.footText: Exception age, manual rework and reconciliation completeness.

items.title: Customer-service hand-offs
items.description: When enquiries move between channels, context and ownership can be lost.
items.bullets:
Workflow - Connect CRM and service channels with case status and escalation paths.
Control - Service teams own escalations; approved knowledge and access rules guide responses.
items.footText: Hand-off completion, repeat contacts and resolution time.

items.title: Legacy application modernisation
items.description: When older applications constrain change, begin with dependencies rather than a wholesale rebuild.
items.bullets:
Workflow - Map APIs, rebuild selected components and integrate regression checks into releases.
Control - Engineering owners approve quality and security gates before deployment.
items.footText: Regression coverage, release defects and interface reliability.

items.title: Churn and segmentation insight
items.description: When customer and usage data is fragmented, prediction needs a governed foundation.
items.bullets:
Workflow - Prepare permitted data and evaluate churn or segmentation models for analyst review.
Control - Agree data rights, model validation and limits on automated action.
items.footText: Model performance, data quality and analyst adoption.

sections.heading: Telecom software and accelerators
sections.description: Select software and accelerators to support your telecom workflows. Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without services.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Composable applications, REST APIs and UI components for service workflows where ERP or CRM does not fit.

items.title: testoriumz
items.description: Continuous quality engineering: low-code testing, AI root-cause analysis and CI/CD integration.

items.title: VectorX
items.description: Code scanning and supply-chain analysis from repository to release, supporting engineering security gates.

items.title: Predictive Analytics Suite
items.description: Pre-built churn and segmentation capability to evaluate against permitted customer data and agreed measures.

items.title: VajraX
items.description: External attack-surface exposure validation where assets, ownership and remediation scope can be agreed.

sections.heading: Which service journey needs to work better?
sections.description: A proposed engagement sequence to agree workflow scope, delivery controls, acceptance measures and operating ownership.

items.title: Frame the workflow
items.description: Start with one billing, support or application-change constraint and its accountable owner.
items.bullets:
Inputs - current applications, interface inventory and process samples
Output - prioritised workflow and dependency map

items.title: Design controlled change
items.description: Agree customer-data access, escalation ownership and quality/security gates. Churn work depends on usable history and model validation.
items.bullets:
Artefacts - interface map, access matrix and review checkpoints
Quality gate - agreed tests and exception handling

items.title: Agree acceptance and operation
items.description: Define a baseline for the selected service or release measure, acceptance criteria and operating ownership.
items.bullets:
Artefacts - acceptance measures, release evidence and ownership plan
Commercial model - project, managed service or dedicated team

sections.note: We can agree an NDA before sharing confidential information. Do not send customer records, credentials or sensitive network details in the initial enquiry.
